fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 9.27 per cent of tertiary graduates in Tanzania in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 12.6 per cent of tertiary graduates in Tanzania in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 13.6 per cent of tertiary graduates in Tanzania in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 13.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Tanzania in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
